fds: # 1 Purpose and scope
Monitors one pump's run feedback against its run command and raises latched faults when they disagree for too long. It does not start or stop the pump; the run command comes from elsewhere.
# 2 Description of operation

When the pump is commanded to run, the run feedback is expected within StartCheckTime seconds. When the command is removed, the feedback is expected to drop within StopCheckTime seconds. If either does not happen, the matching fault latches and stays on until the operator resets it.
# 3 Control logic
3.1 While Enable is FALSE the block is idle: faults are cleared, timers are stopped and StatusString shows "Disabled".
3.2 The start check timer runs while RunCmd is TRUE, RunFbk is FALSE and FailToStart is not already latched.
3.3 When the start check timer reaches StartCheckTime, FailToStart latches TRUE.
3.4 The stop check timer runs while RunCmd is FALSE, RunFbk is TRUE and FailToStop is not already latched.
3.5 When the stop check timer reaches StopCheckTime, FailToStop latches TRUE.
3.6 A rising edge on FaultReset clears FailToStart and FailToStop and restarts both checks.
3.7 Fault is TRUE whenever FailToStart or FailToStop is TRUE.
# 4 Alarms and faults
| Fault | Raised when | Latches | Reset |
| FailToStart | Run commanded, no feedback for StartCheckTime s | Yes | Rising edge on FaultReset |
| FailToStop | Command removed, feedback still on after StopCheckTime s | Yes | Rising edge on FaultReset |
# 5 Operator interface
The operator can adjust StartCheckTime and StopCheckTime. The HMI shows FailToStart, FailToStop, Fault, State and StatusString.
# 6 Assumptions and open points
- ASSUMPTION: 10 s is long enough for the starter to pull in and drop out.
- A fault does not stop the pump itself; the calling logic must use Fault to interlock the run command if required.
# 7 Test plan
| No. | Action | Expected result |
| 1 | Set RunCmd TRUE, give RunFbk within 10 s | No fault, State 2, "Running" |
| 2 | Set RunCmd TRUE, hold RunFbk FALSE for 10 s | FailToStart and Fault TRUE, State 9 |
| 3 | Remove RunCmd, hold RunFbk TRUE for 10 s | FailToStop and Fault TRUE, State 9 |
| 4 | Pulse FaultReset with feedback correct | Faults clear, State follows the pump |
| 5 | Hold FaultReset TRUE while the fault returns | Fault latches again; reset needs a new rising edge |
| 6 | Set Enable FALSE, then TRUE | "Disabled" shown, then block restarts with no faults |
pseudo_code: start_check.IN = RunCmd AND NOT RunFbk AND NOT FailToStart
stop_check.IN = NOT RunCmd AND RunFbk AND NOT FailToStop
IF start_check done THEN FailToStart = TRUE
IF stop_check done THEN FailToStop = TRUE

block.name: PumpRunMon
block.title: Pump run feedback monitor
block.author: ENGINEER
block.purpose: Checks a pump's run feedback against its run command and latches fail to start / fail to stop faults.
how_it_works: Fail to start: RunCmd is TRUE but RunFbk is not seen within StartCheckTime seconds.
Fail to stop: RunCmd is FALSE but RunFbk is still TRUE after StopCheckTime seconds.
Faults latch until a rising edge on FaultReset. Fault is the OR of both faults.

inputs.name: Enable
inputs.comment: Block enable, must be TRUE for any monitoring to run

inputs.name: RunCmd
inputs.comment: Run command sent to the pump starter

inputs.name: RunFbk
inputs.comment: Run feedback from the starter auxiliary contact

inputs.name: FaultReset
inputs.comment: Fault reset, rising edge clears latched faults

inputs.name: StartCheckTime
inputs.comment: Seconds allowed for run feedback after the run command

inputs.name: StopCheckTime
inputs.comment: Seconds allowed for run feedback to drop after the command is removed

inputs.name: SampleTime
inputs.comment: Cycle time of the PLC in seconds, used for timer logic

outputs.name: FailToStart
outputs.comment: Latched fault, no run feedback within StartCheckTime

outputs.name: FailToStop
outputs.comment: Latched fault, run feedback still present after StopCheckTime

outputs.name: Fault
outputs.comment: Common fault, TRUE if either fault is latched

outputs.name: State
outputs.comment: State, 0 = stopped, 1 = starting, 2 = running, 3 = stopping, 9 = fault

outputs.name: StatusString
outputs.comment: Diagnostic status string for the operator screen

statics.name: FaultResetPrev
statics.comment: FaultReset value from the previous scan for rising edge detection

logic_sections.title: Fault detection
description: Each check timer runs while command and feedback disagree.
A timer elapsing latches the matching fault.
logic_sections.scl:
{timer:start_check}.IN := RunCmd AND NOT RunFbk AND NOT FailToStart; // Commanded on, no feedback yet
{timer:stop_check}.IN := NOT RunCmd AND RunFbk AND NOT FailToStop; // Commanded off, feedback still on

IF {timer:start_check}.Q THEN
    FailToStart := TRUE; // Latch fail to start
END_IF;

IF {timer:stop_check}.Q THEN
    FailToStop := TRUE; // Latch fail to stop
END_IF;

logic_sections.title: Fault reset
description: A rising edge on FaultReset clears both latched faults and restarts the checks.

states.name: Stopping
states.status: Stopping: Waiting for feedback to drop
